blockers.message: the review record has no `## plan.challenge` section, while roles were active at it
R-migration-1 (`rename_all = "camelCase"` renames every existing field of the public order JSON) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it
R-migration-2 (New required `default_currency` key makes existing `config.toml` files fail to load) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.evidence:
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct OrderResponse {
    pub order_id: i64,
    pub customer_id: i64,
    pub total_cents: i64,
findings.recommendation: Remove `#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]` so `GET /orders/{id}` keeps emitting `order_id`, `customer_id` and `total_cents`; the new field `currency` is a single word and needs no renaming. Today a partner's integration reading `order_id`, `customer_id` or `total_cents` gets a missing field (deserialization error or null) on the first response after deploy, with no warning: the change ships no BREAKING item, the release note only says "Added: Orders carry their `currency`", and `docs/api.md` still lists the snake_case names and promises "a field is never renamed or removed without two releases of deprecation". If camelCase is wanted, it must go through that deprecation (emit both names for two releases), be marked BREAKING in the release note, and be reflected in `docs/api.md`.
findings.title: `rename_all = "camelCase"` renames every existing field of the public order JSON

findings.evidence:
/// The currency of orders that do not name one (ISO 4217).
pub default_currency: String,
findings.recommendation: Give the field a default (`#[serde(default = "default_currency")]` returning `"EUR"`, the currency the shop sold in before this change) so a deployed `config.toml` holding only `database_url` and `listen` keeps loading. As written, `toml::from_str` returns `missing field `default_currency`` for every existing configuration file and the service refuses to start after the upgrade; only `config.example.toml` was updated, and the release note announces no manual step. If the key must stay required, mark it BREAKING in the release note with the line to add, and add a test loading a config without the key.
findings.title: New required `default_currency` key makes existing `config.toml` files fail to load
